card.name: Digits inside resistance mutation codes
card.fires_on: Digits partway through amino-acid substitution codes such as I54M or I50V in lists of resistance-associated mutations. Also fires on a few odd mid-word splits like the S in Pip, Squeak or the ip in rabeprazole-type names.

modes.label: Odd mid-word splits
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a name, outside mutation lists.
